Here's a concise roundup of the latest on **Medtronic** (NYSE: MDT):

### Major Corporate Moves
- **MiniMed Separation:** On Sept. 14, 2026, Medtronic launched an exchange offer to complete the separation of **MiniMed Group** (Nasdaq: MMED), its former Diabetes business. The offer allows Medtronic shareholders to exchange their shares for MiniMed stock in a transaction expected to be generally tax‑free for U.S. federal income tax purposes. The final exchange ratio is expected to be set using pricing from Oct. 5–7, 2026.  
  Sources: [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/medtronic-launches-exchange-offer-to-complete-separation-of-minimed-group-inc-302877119.html), [Medtronic Newsroom](https://news.medtronic.com/2026-09-14-Medtronic-Launches-Exchange-Offer-to-Complete-Separation-of-MiniMed-Group,-Inc)

### Product & Regulatory Wins
- **Cardiac Mapping Software:** Announced Sept. 30, 2026 — Medtronic received **FDA clearance and CE Mark** for its **Affera™ Prism‑2 Mapping Software** and a **CE Mark** for the **PulseSelect ProxBox™ Adapter** with Proximity Indicator software, expanding capabilities for cardiac ablation.  
  Source: [Medtronic Newsroom](https://news.medtronic.com/2026-09-30-Medtronic-announces-regulatory-milestones-for-newest-cardiac-mapping-and-ablation-software)
- **Surgical Robotics:** The **FDA cleared** the **LigaSure™ RAS Maryland** instrument for use with Medtronic’s **Hugo™ robotic‑assisted surgery system**.  
  Source: [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/healthcare/nyse-mdt/medtronic/news/medtronic-mdt-why-is-its-latest-update-drawing-attention)
- **CPT Codes:** New **Category I CPT® codes** were approved for Medtronic’s **Altaviva™** and **Symplicity Spyral™** renal denervation systems.  
  Source: [Stock Titan / SEC filings](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MDT/425-medtronic-plc-business-combination-communication-09698ae86f38.html)

### Financial Performance
- **Q1 Fiscal 2027:** Medtronic reported **13.7% organic growth** for its fiscal first quarter of 2027, though roughly 6.7 percentage points were attributed to an extra selling week. Even without that boost, management called it the strongest underlying performance in nearly eight years.  
- **Stock:** Shares have traded recently around **$86–$88**, down about **6.4% since the last earnings report**. Some valuation models suggest the stock is roughly **23% undervalued** relative to estimated fair value (~$115).  
  Source: [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/healthcare/nyse-mdt/medtronic/news/medtronic-mdt-why-is-its-latest-update-drawing-attention)

### Recognition
- **Fortune “Change the World” List:** Medtronic was named to the **2026 Fortune “Change the World” list** for its **Touch Surgery™ ecosystem** and **Healthy Neighbor** program, recognized for using AI to improve surgical outcomes globally.  
  Source: [Yahoo Finance / Access Newswire](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/medtronic-named-fortune-2026-change-132500529.html)
